subject: Day 1: the 10-deal habit that makes Pro pay for itself
preheader: Analyze 10 deals in your first 30 days — it's the guarantee condition, and it's how you find the one.
headline: You have full Pro. Here's the one habit that matters.
body: Welcome to your trial — everything is unlocked: the Max Offer Engine, Buy Box verdicts, the downside stress test, comparisons, and lender-ready reports.

One ask: analyze 10 deals. Not because we said so — because reps are where offer confidence comes from, and it's the condition of the Never Overpay Guarantee once billing starts. Deals you run during the trial count toward the 10, and if you're not more confident about exactly what to offer after them, every dollar you go on to pay comes back.
Fifteen minutes a day on new listings in your market gets you there in a week. Paste an address, read the verdict, check your Buy Box, note the Max Offer, next.
signature_note: The full path from screening to a submitted offer is written down at usetruecap.com/playbook.
